subject.title: feat: clarify publisher discovery state labels

question: Should this PR establish the publisher profile/discovery trust-label vocabulary now, or wait for the adjacent account-feed/follow/review-state stack?
rationale: The code change is narrow, but the new spec intentionally makes trust-label vocabulary durable and only maintainers can decide whether that product language should land before related feed/state drafts.

options.title: Accept Narrow Vocabulary After Proof
options.body: Add real browser proof, then land this Official/profile-state wording as the current product direction for this slice.

options.title: Consolidate With Feed Stack
options.body: Hold this PR until the related feed and state drafts define the shared vocabulary together.

options.title: Keep Spec Separate From UI
options.body: Ask for a narrower PR that only changes the UI copy or only records the spec intent.
